## DroppedExpiryAttribute type

An expiry-related attribute that appeared in the `Set-Cookie` string but was ignored because it was invalid.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type DroppedExpiryAttribute = {
    attribute: 'expires';
    raw: string | null;
    reason: 'empty' | 'invalid-date';
} | {
    attribute: 'max-age';
    raw: string | null;
    reason: 'empty' | 'invalid-integer';
};
```
